description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkShiftModel class, which represents the work shift times (start and end) for an employee within the HRM system. It implements serialization of these times to an array format suitable for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShiftModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing employee work shift times (start and end) for API responses.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the work shift start and end times into an array with 'startTime' and 'endTime' keys.
